using System;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.server;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class VectorManagerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void ResumePostRecovery_LogsErrorOnTryDeleteVectorSetException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(loggerMock.Object);

            var serverOptions = new GarnetServerOptions { EnableVectorSetPreview = true, VectorSetReplayTaskCount = 1 };
            var vectorManager = new VectorManager(1, serverOptions, () => new FakeRespServerSession(), loggerFactoryMock.Object);

            // We need to simulate a failed delete that throws an exception to trigger the LogError call.
            // The easiest way is to create a derived class that overrides TryDeleteVectorSet to throw.
            var testVectorManager = new TestVectorManager(1, serverOptions, () => new FakeRespServerSession(), loggerFactoryMock.Object);

            // Act
            testVectorManager.InvokeResumePostRecoveryWithFailedDelete();

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Attempt at normal cleanup of")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        // A derived class to override TryDeleteVectorSet to throw an exception to test the catch block.
        private class TestVectorManager : VectorManager
        {
            public TestVectorManager(int dbId, GarnetServerOptions options, Func<IMessageConsumer> getCleanupSession, ILoggerFactory loggerFactory)
                : base(dbId, options, getCleanupSession, loggerFactory)
            {
            }

            public void InvokeResumePostRecoveryWithFailedDelete()
            {
                // We simulate the failed delete by calling the internal method that contains the try-catch block.
                // Since the original method is private, we simulate the scenario by calling ResumePostRecovery,
                // but we override TryDeleteVectorSet to throw.

                ResumePostRecovery();
            }

            // Override TryDeleteVectorSet to throw exception to trigger the catch block.
            protected override ValueTask<GarnetStatus> TryDeleteVectorSet(StorageSession storageSession, ref SpanByte toDeleteKeySpanByte, out GarnetStatus garnetStatus)
            {
                garnetStatus = GarnetStatus.BADSTATE;
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulated failure");
            }
        }

        // Minimal fake implementations to satisfy dependencies.
        private class FakeRespServerSession : IMessageConsumer, IDisposable
        {
            public int activeDbId => 1;
            public StorageSession storageSession { get; } = new StorageSession();
            public void Dispose() { }
            public bool TrySwitchActiveDatabaseSession(int dbId) => true;
        }

        private class StorageSession
        {
            public BasicContext basicContext { get; } = new BasicContext();
            public VectorContext vectorContext { get; } = new VectorContext();
        }

        private class BasicContext
        {
            public ValueTask<OperationStatus> RMW(ref SpanByte key, ref RawStringInput input) => new ValueTask<OperationStatus>(OperationStatus.Success);
            public OperationStatus Delete(ref SpanByte key) => new OperationStatus { Found = true };
        }

        private class VectorContext
        {
            public OperationStatus Read(ref SpanByte key, ref SpanByte data) => new OperationStatus { Found = true };
        }

        private struct OperationStatus
        {
            public bool Found;
            public bool NotFound;
            public bool IsPending;
        }

        private struct RawStringInput
        {
            public RawStringInput(RespCommand command) { }
        }

        private enum RespCommand
        {
            VADD
        }

        private struct SpanByte
        {
            public ReadOnlySpan<byte> Span => ReadOnlySpan<byte>.Empty;
            public static SpanByte FromPinnedPointer(byte* ptr, int length) => new SpanByte();
            public static SpanByte FromPinnedSpan(Span<byte> span) => new SpanByte();
        }

        private enum GarnetStatus
        {
            BADSTATE,
            NOTFOUND
        }

        private class GarnetServerOptions
        {
            public bool EnableVectorSetPreview { get; set; }
            public int VectorSetReplayTaskCount { get; set; }
        }

        private interface IMessageConsumer : IDisposable
        {
            int activeDbId { get; }
            StorageSession storageSession { get; }
            bool TrySwitchActiveDatabaseSession(int dbId);
        }
    }
}
